get.summary: Stream hop: the public URL points to https://m3m8.gradetv.net; the apex still answers 302 for compatibility. Media stays direct. It counts the play once per person, channel and day.
get.description:
It is the address that appears in the M3U and in the API: https://m3m8.gradetv.net/api/s/:id, with CORS * and no-store for the per-network policy. Live HLS has 120 free minutes per network per UTC day; after that, it shows our own video with a QR for the 30-, 90- or 365-day pass, from 0.10 USDC. Old links at gradetv.net/api/s/ still answer 302 no-store to the same path. The Grade does not retransmit third-party signals: the segments and keys come from the origin, in the browser and in VLC. Inner playlists use the same hop with a signed `p`; copy the full URL, without building the ticket. Each fetch has a cap of 512 KiB, 8 s and 3 revalidated redirects; up to 128 inner references per manifest and 4 levels. An inner refresh does not count another play. A playlist failure at o2 is a 422 JSON. No redirect to HTTP. Headers exposed by CORS: X-Grade-TV-Codigo (notice code), X-Grade-Upstream-Status (status observed at the origin), X-Grade-Source (original broadcast URL to copy), X-Grade-Website (official site of the channel, empty when missing), X-Grade-Legacy (public HTTP action) and X-Grade-Media-HTTP (1 if this manifest references HTTP media/key, 0 otherwise). HTTP media offers a standalone legacy player; a 401/403 from the origin offers to open the channel site and to copy the original playlist to another player. CORS can still prevent playback. Continuous audio/video and YouTube get a 302 to the origin. New IDs do not depend on the reload order. A missing old positional ID recovers a stream of the same channel, feed and source, keeping the blocks.
Returns: The playlist is `application/vnd.apple.mpegurl` at m3m8.gradetv.net, with inner playlists through the hop and media with an absolute origin URI. A legacy request on the apex can 302 to this host. A continuous stream/YouTube gets a 302 to the provider.

post.description:
Requires the `cancelamento` ticket returned at creation. An old credit charge accepts its token in `credito`. It acts only in the product and environment of origin. It does not refund payments or remove the history. 202 shows a cancellation in progress; the watcher retries external failures.
Returns: { id, estado }

get.summary: Automatic Pix: whether it is available in this app, the packages in reais and the balance that the product sells.
get.description: Returns: { disponivel, pacotes, exatos, saldo, precisa_documento }

disponivel.description: `false` when the app does not have Asaas configured (use the Pix with a receipt).

pacotes.description: The credit packages (3, 5, 10 or 25 dollars), with `brl_centavos`.

exatos.description: Prices that the app declares, with `usd` and `brl_centavos`. They appear only from R$ 5.00 up to R$ 10,000.

saldo.description: When the product sells balance in reais: the range and whether the signed-in account can buy.

precisa_documento.description: Whether the payer's CPF or CNPJ is still requested.

post.summary: Creates a dynamic Pix: JSON with `oferta` (`pacote` with `usd`, or `saldo` with `centavos`) and the payer.
post.description:
The payment releases by itself what was bought: the package becomes the `cred_…` token that already comes in the answer; the balance goes to the organization of the signed-in account. The first purchase sends `documento` (CPF or CNPJ, which goes to the gateway and is not kept here) and `nome`; `email`, `pagina` and `navegador_id` are optional and are recorded. With `forma: "cartao_boleto"`, the charge is open: the answer has `pagamento_em`, the gateway page where you pay by card, boleto or Pix (due in three days). With `forma: "cartao"` and the `cartao` (`titular`, `numero`, `mes`, `ano`, `cvv`, `documento`, `email`, `cep`, `numero_endereco`, `telefone`), the charge is paid by card in the same request: 200 with `estado: "pago"`, 202 with `conferir` while the issuer reviews, 422 when the card is declined; the card is not kept. The `usd` must be a value from `pacotes` or `exatos` of the GET. The server sets the cents and refuses values that are not declared.
Returns: { id, credito, forma, pix, pagamento_em, estado, estado_em, cancelamento }

200.description: { id, credito, forma, pix, pagamento_em, estado, estado_em, cancelamento }

credito.description: With a package: the `cred_…` token, shown ONCE; it is valid when the payment clears.

pix.description: `copia_e_cola`, `imagem` (QR in PNG, data URI) and `expira_em`; only in the `pix` form.

pagamento_em.description: In the `cartao_boleto` form: the payment page of the gateway.

cancelamento.description: Ticket to cancel the pending Pix or boleto charge.

400.description: Credit outside `pacotes` and `exatos`, value out of range, invalid CPF/CNPJ, name or e-mail, invalid card data (`cartao_dados`, with the `campo`), or the gateway refused the payer (`pagador_recusado`, with the reason in `detalhe`).

422.description: Card declined (`cartao_recusado`, with the `campo` when the gateway tells which); change it at `POST /api/credito/asaas/:id/cartao`.

429.description: Limit of 3 attempts per minute or 10 per day, per account or network, or the card limit.

502.description: The gateway did not create the Pix; try again.

503.description: Automatic Pix unavailable in this app, the gateway is busy (`asaas_ocupado`, wait `retry_after_s`), or too many charges awaiting payment from a person who is not signed in.

post.summary: Pays, with another card, a card charge whose card was declined: the same charge, without charging twice.
post.description:
JSON with the `cartao` (the same fields as `POST /api/credito/asaas`) and, without an account, the `navegador_id` that created the charge. Only a card charge that waits for payment, by the person who created it, and up to five attempts per charge.

parameters.description: Charge ID (32 hex).

409.description: The charge has expired or was closed; start the payment again.

429.description: Card attempts for this charge or for the day exceeded.
